study: Drummond et al. 2020, Children's Literacy Initiative i3 Scale-Up (AIR)
delivery_evidence: CLI PD = seminar training (~), classroom-embedded coaching (105 coaching hrs), instructional-lead-teacher mentoring/model classrooms, and facilitated grade-level meetings 'in schools' over 3 years (design narrative; intervention components section).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes = GRADE total score and state end-of-year ELA assessments (FSA/CMAS/STAAR/PARCC), broad standardized tests not tailored to CLI (Tables 8 & 10, physical pp.27,29).
curriculum_evidence: CLI 'provides classrooms with books and materials aligned with the intervention model' in Year 1, plus a CLI-developed model (intervention components section); PD tied to adopting CLI structured-literacy materials.
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effects are Year 3 / 2018-19, the final intervention year (end of treatment); same-year measurement (Tables 8 & 10, physical pp.27,29).
